title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When you add more features to a model, it can become more complex. Think about how this complexity might affect the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Training vs. Testing Error
text: Consider what it means when the training error decreases but the testing error increases. What does this tell you about the model's performance on unseen data?

title: Impact of More Features
text: What happens to the model's complexity when more features are added?

hintAnswer: The model may not generalize well to new data.
title: Generalization to New Data
text: If a model performs well on training data but poorly on testing data, what might this indicate about its ability to generalize?
choices: The model may not generalize well to new data.
The model generalizes perfectly to new data.
The model's generalization ability is unaffected.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Think about how adding more features might affect the bias and variance of the model. Which one increases, and which one decreases?
